name: ingenidev UK Zones and Counties for WC
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
NEW Plugin! This WooCommerce plugin by ingenidev allows you to select each UK county as a configurable shipping zone with its own options.

WordPress and WooCommerce already have a feature called “shipping zones” that helps online stores manage their shipping logistics. However, this feature is not configured for the UK’s specific delivery requirements, where deliveries are often organized by county and region. The UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce plugin specifically adds counties to the system, allowing store owners to easily configure delivery rules within the UK context. It integrates seamlessly with the existing system, providing precise control over shipping costs and delivery times for each county.

Simplify Shipping in the UK with the UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce Plugin

Simplify your WooCommerce checkout process for UK customers with the UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce plugin. This plugin replaces standard address fields with a user-friendly county and region selection, ensuring accurate and efficient delivery throughout the United Kingdom.

WordPress and WooCommerce already have a feature called “shipping zones” that helps online stores manage their shipping logistics. However, this feature is not configured for the UK’s specific delivery requirements, where deliveries are organized by county and region rather than default zones. The UK Zones and Counties plugin adds counties and regions to the system, allowing store owners to easily configure delivery rules within the UK context.

Why Optimize UK Addresses in WooCommerce?

Using standard address fields can lead to confusion and errors for UK customers. By implementing county-specific fields, you can:

✓ Improve Checkout Experience: Provide more intuitive and localized address input.
✓ Reduce Delivery Errors: Ensure accurate address data for faster and more reliable deliveries.
✓ Enhance Customer Satisfaction: Offer a seamless checkout process tailored to UK users.
✓ Optimize Delivery Logistics: Simplify address management for UK-specific delivery.
✓ Handle Special Zones: Easily configure different rates for Scottish Highlands, Islands, and Northern Ireland.

UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce Plugin Features

✅ Replaces Standard Address Fields: Replaces default address fields with a county dropdown.
✅ Easy County Selection: Allows customers to select their county from a comprehensive list (108 counties across all UK nations).
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration and Shipping Zone Configuration.
✅ Works flawlessly with all WooCommerce themes and plugins.
✅ Simple and Easy Configuration: No complex settings or coding required.
✅ Lightweight and Optimized: Designed for minimal impact on your store’s performance.
✅ Complete UK Coverage: England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland included.

How to Use This Plugin?

  1. Install and activate the UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce plugin.
  2. The plugin automatically replaces standard address fields with county selection.
  3. No additional configuration is usually necessary unless you need specific rules per county – it’s ready to use!
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping to configure your shipping zones by county if needed.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • WooCommerce store owners who ship products within the United Kingdom.
  • Businesses looking to improve the checkout experience for UK customers.
  • E-commerce stores aiming to reduce delivery errors and improve delivery efficiency and accuracy.
  • Shops that want to provide localized and user-friendly address input.
  • Stores needing different shipping rates for Scottish Highlands, Islands, or Northern Ireland.

Included Counties

The plugin includes all UK counties organized by nation:

England (48 counties)
– All ceremonial counties including Greater London, Greater Manchester, Merseyside, etc.
– Metropolitan and non-metropolitan counties

Wales (22 counties)
– All 22 principal areas including Cardiff, Swansea, Gwynedd, etc.

Scotland (32 counties)
– All 32 council areas including Edinburgh, Glasgow, Highland, Orkney Islands, Shetland Islands, etc.

Northern Ireland (6 counties)
– All 6 traditional counties: Antrim, Armagh, Down, Fermanagh, Londonderry, Tyrone

Optimize Your Shipping in the UK Today!

Enhance your WooCommerce store’s shipping capabilities for UK customers with the UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce plugin. Ensure accurate and efficient deliveries with localized address selection.

Privacy Notice

This plugin, by itself, does not:

  • track users;
  • write any user personal data to the database;
  • send any data to external servers;
  • use cookies.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support different shipping rates for Scottish Highlands and Islands?

Yes! You can create separate shipping zones for Highland, Orkney Islands, Shetland Islands, and Eilean Siar (Western Isles) council areas.

Does this plugin work with Northern Ireland?

Yes! All 6 Northern Ireland counties are included, allowing you to set specific shipping rates for this region.

Do you have questions or issues with the UK Zones and Counties for WooCommerce plugin? Use these appropriate support channels.

  1. Website
  2. Support
